name: Pearl Jam

whyMatters.en: Seattle grunge band formed in 1990. Ten (1991) remains the mass entry; later years emphasize long-running tours and the mid-90s Ticketmaster dispute.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图 grunge 乐队，1990 年成立。《Ten》（1991）仍是大众入口；之后以长期巡演与 90 年代中期 Ticketmaster 争端为重要记录。

note.en: Ten-era track; Vedder baritone, McCready lead, open-chord rhythm.
note.zh: Ten 时期作品；Vedder 男中音、McCready 主音、开放和弦节奏。

note.en: Ten single with a narrative video; heavy MTV play.
Funk-tinged riff; live staple from the debut cycle.
note.zh: 带放克味的 riff；首专周期起的现场常备曲。

shortBio.en: Vedder / McCready / Gossard Seattle grunge, 1990–. Alive and Jeremy are the main Ten-era entry points.
shortBio.zh: Vedder / McCready / Gossard 的西雅图 grunge，1990 年至今。《Alive》与《Jeremy》是 Ten 时期的主要入口。

body.en:
Pearl Jam formed in Seattle in 1990 from Green River and Mother Love Bone members plus Eddie Vedder. Ten (1991) and Vs. (1993) put them on MTV and rock radio beside Nirvana and Soundgarden. Vitalogy (1994) and later albums extend the catalog.

Alive (1991) is a core reference track here. Musically: open chords, McCready leads, Vedder’s baritone. Later history includes bootleg-heavy touring and the mid-90s Ticketmaster dispute.
body.zh:
Pearl Jam 于 1990 年在西雅图成立，成员来自 Green River、Mother Love Bone，并加入 Eddie Vedder。《Ten》（1991）与《Vs.》（1993）使其进入 MTV 与摇滚电台，与 Nirvana、Soundgarden 并列。《Vitalogy》（1994）及之后专辑延续目录。

《Alive》（1991）是此处核心参照曲。音乐上：开放和弦、McCready 主音、Vedder 男中音。后期记录包括大量现场录音巡演与 90 年代中期 Ticketmaster 争端。

title.en: Ten on MTV and rock radio

body.en:
Ten (1991) places Pearl Jam on MTV and rock radio beside Nirvana and Soundgarden. Open chords, Vedder’s baritone, and McCready leads are the easiest identifiers.

After the early-90s boom, the band kept a long touring schedule. The Ticketmaster dispute is part of that later institutional record.
body.zh:
《Ten》（1991）把 Pearl Jam 推上 MTV 与摇滚电台，与 Nirvana、Soundgarden 并列。开放和弦、Vedder 男中音与 McCready 主音是最易辨认的元素。

90 年代初热潮之后，乐队维持长期巡演。Ticketmaster 争端属于其后的制度记录。

body.en:
Vedder, McCready, Gossard, Ament, and Krusen recorded Ten. The drum seat later rotated (Abbruzzese, Irons, Cameron); the guitar and vocal core stayed.

Radio memory of the debut still centers on that five.
body.zh:
Vedder、McCready、Gossard、Ament 与 Krusen 录制《Ten》。鼓席后来轮换（Abbruzzese、Irons、Cameron）；吉他与人声核心保留。

首专的电台记忆仍集中在这五人。

body.en:
Alive opens with a family-story lyric and a McCready solo. Jeremy pairs a narrative video with a mid-tempo arrangement. Even Flow stays a live riff staple from the debut cycle.

Those three tracks cover much of Ten’s mass radio face.
body.zh:
《Alive》以家庭故事歌词与 McCready 独奏开场。《Jeremy》把叙事录像与中速编配配对。《Even Flow》自首专周期起是现场 riff 常备曲。

这三首覆盖了《Ten》在大众电台上的主要面孔。

title.zh: 男中音、主音与节奏分工

body.en:
Vedder’s baritone sits forward in the mix. McCready supplies blues-rock leads, often on Les Paul. Gossard and Ament bring rhythm parts from the Mother Love Bone / Green River background.

Compared with Nirvana, there is less quiet-loud switching and more open-chord hard-rock weight.
body.zh:
Vedder 的男中音在混音里靠前。McCready 提供蓝调摇滚主音，常用 Les Paul。Gossard 与 Ament 带入 Mother Love Bone / Green River 背景的节奏写法。

与 Nirvana 相比，强弱切换更少，更偏开放和弦 hard-rock 重量。

title.zh: 反明星表述与体育场体量

body.en:
Vedder’s backup-singer line and Gossard’s “just wanted to play music” claim document early-90s posture beside large venues.

Read them against Ten’s radio saturation as period evidence, not as a puzzle to erase.
body.zh:
Vedder「宁可当和声」与 Gossard「只想弹琴」的表述，记录了大场馆体量旁的 90 年代初姿态。

对照《Ten》的电台饱和阅读，当作同期证据，而不是要抹掉的矛盾。

title.zh: 90 年代初热潮之后的巡演

body.en:
Vs., Vitalogy, and later albums extend the career. Official and unofficial live recordings, plus anti-scalping campaigns, are part of how the band ran tours.

Several Seattle peers slowed or split; Pearl Jam kept a long touring calendar into later decades.
body.zh:
《Vs.》《Vitalogy》与后期专辑延长职业线。官方与非官方现场录音，以及反黄牛行动，是巡演运作的一部分。

部分西雅图同辈放缓或解散；Pearl Jam 在之后数十年仍保持较长巡演日程。

note.zh: 首专引用阵容；Krusen 在《Ten》后离队。
